question.text: Which of the following is a key benefit of diversification across asset classes?

answer.text: It guarantees positive returns in all market conditions
It manages portfolio risk by spreading investments across asset classes that perform differently
It eliminates all forms of investment risk
It ensures the portfolio always beats inflation

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes diversification across asset classes as a way to rationalize and manage risk, protect the portfolio against decline in one or a few asset classes, and balance losses because different asset classes perform differently. The Trap: Diversification does not guarantee positive returns, does not eliminate all risk and does not ensure that the portfolio always beats inflation. The "systematic vs unsystematic" labels are not used in this workbook section and should not be relied on here. Note: The diversification across asset classes concept — spreading across asset classes that perform differently to balance losses and manage risk — is covered on pages 45-46 and 158-159 of the NISM Series XVII Retirement Adviser Certification Examination workbook (June 2025, version 02).
